clinic.source: fictional clinic and number for the demo

staff_call_after_hours.label: No answer to the automated message, then a staff call task

staff_call_due_hours.label: Deadline of the staff call task

callback_due_hours.label: Deadline of the call the patient asked for

navigator_after_hours.label: Still no movement after the staff call step, then the navigator

notes: Atlas et al. (JAMA 2023) sent letters in week 2 and phone calls in week 4. That is too slow for the 31-day referral-to-colonoscopy limit, so these values are deliberately shorter: message on day 0, staff call on day 2, navigator on day 4. They are starting values for the clinical review (TICKET-19), not findings.
